articles.summary:

The app-data seeder joins paths from existing distribution metadata to site-packages and deletes the resulting paths

Anthropic's OSS Scanner reported this as `ANT-2026-SXOEHWP7` in `virtualenv-20261015-005`, received on 15 October 2026.

Removal of a previously installed seed package.

articles.title: GHSA: Happy DOM: Incomplete fix for CVE-2026-33943: unsanitized import alias leads to host code execution
articles.summary:
## Summary

The ESM compiler in `happy-dom@20.14.5` does not validate imported local binding aliases before interpolating them into generated JavaScript.

As a result, an invalid ESM import alias can be transformed into a valid JavaScript destructuring default initializer and executed.

isofs: handle set_blocksize failures

isofs uses buffer_heads, which don't handle block size > PAGE_SIZE well.
Without this, mounting we will hit the

in folio_set_bh on the first __bread_gfp call.

articles.title: CVE-2026-98875
articles.summary:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

drm/nouveau/gsp: add SEC2 to GA100 chip table

The booter-load and booter-unload firmware run on the SEC2 falcon.
During tu102_gsp_oneinit(), the booter constructor needs device->sec2
to access the SEC2 falcon.

Without the .sec2 entry, device->sec2 is NULL and this dereference
crashes during GSP-RM boot.
